description: September 20 birthday meaning: Virgo decan 3, birthday number 2, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a September 20 birthday falls in Virgo, in the third decan, with Mercury as the sign's ruler and Venus as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 2. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Virgo is mutable and earth.

sections.heading: The September 20 birthday in astrology
paragraphs: Twenty-seven degrees into Virgo, the 20th of September leans towards partnership. Twenty reduces to 2, a number associated with cooperation, listening and balance, and the Venus sub-ruler of the third decan adds affection to Virgo's practical care. The combined reading is a supportive collaborator, the person who makes a team run smoothly and only occasionally lets anyone see how much effort that takes.

Astronomically, September 20 puts the Sun near 27° Virgo in most years, inside the third ten-degree slice of the sign, which tradition links with Venus. Venus, ruler of Taurus, softens the last decan of Virgo, from roughly September 13 to September 22. The sign's practicality is joined by an eye for beauty, comfort and craft. Late-Virgo birthdays are often linked with gardening, design, cooking or any work where precision produces something pleasant to live with. Relationships may matter more than the classic Virgo stereotype suggests, and these natives tend to show love through thoughtful, tangible acts. Venus can encourage perfectionism about appearances too. Accepting that something can be lovely and unfinished at the same time usually brings this decan real ease.

sections.heading: Birthday number and Life Path for September 20
paragraphs: A birthday on the 20th reduces as 2 + 0 = 2, giving a birthday number of 2. The 0 is often read as amplifying the 2, intensifying its sensitivity, diplomacy and emotional awareness. Those born on the 20th are frequently described as intuitive companions and natural team members, attuned to atmosphere and moods. They may pick up the feeling in a room before anyone has spoken. As a secondary number in the chart, the 20 tends to show in close relationships and group work. Protecting their own energy, and saying no kindly, is a recurring theme for this birthday.

Add the birth year and the picture shifts again: a September 20 birthday gives Life Path 3 for 1990, 4 for 2000, 5 for 2010 and 6 for 2020. Some birth years on this date reach the master numbers 22 and 33. Read the birthday number as a secondary note beside that main theme.

sections.heading: Season, Chinese zodiac and famous September 20 birthdays
paragraphs: A September birthday arrives at the turn into autumn for the northern hemisphere, a season of new terms and gathering in, and at the start of spring in the southern. Virgo occupies most of the month, with Libra taking over around September 22 or 23, near the equinox. September is month 9 in numerology, the number of completion, compassion and a broad, humanitarian outlook. September 20 is the 263rd day of the year (264th in a leap year). Counting forward, the next sign change, into Libra, is usually complete within 3 days, by September 23.

By September 20 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year. Among the best-known people with a September 20 birthday are Sophia Loren (1934), George R. R. Martin (1948) and Tarō Asō (1940).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is September 20?
faq.answer: September 20 is Virgo in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the third decan of Virgo, which tradition links with Venus.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on September 20?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On September 20 the Life Path is 9 in 1960, 1 in 1970, 2 in 1980, 3 in 1990, 4 in 2000, 5 in 2010 and 6 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 2 for everyone born on the 20th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on September 20?
faq.answer: For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by September 20, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on September 20?
faq.answer: Well-known people born on September 20 include Sophia Loren (1934), George R. R. Martin (1948) and Tarō Asō (1940). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
